raiseIssue.dangerTitle: Are you in danger right now?
raiseIssue.dangerBody: A ticket is read when support reaches it. If you need help this minute, stop somewhere safe and call {{number}}, or call driver support from the Help screen.

pickupCode.locked: This trip needs support to sort out before it can start.
pickupCode.askForCode: Ask your rider for her four-digit code and enter it here. The trip starts once it matches.

sos.title: Need help right now?
sos.body: Call 112 for police, fire or ambulance. You can also send your location to the SheOut safety team, who will call you.
sos.sent: The SheOut safety team has your location and will call you. If you are in danger, call 112 now.
sos.failed: Could not reach SheOut. Call 112 now.

assistant.emergencyTitle: If you are in danger, use SOS now
assistant.emergencyBody: This chat can't help in an emergency. SOS alerts your emergency contacts and SheOut's team with your location. Call {{number}} for police, an ambulance or fire services.
assistant.imSafe: I'm safe - go back to the chat
assistant.privacyNote: Never share OTPs, passwords or ID numbers here.

riderCheck.womenOnly: SheOut is for women only. If the person here is a man, or not the rider shown, do not start the trip.
